Authors: Takafumi Furuhata, Jotaro Miyamoto, Chiharu Moriyama, Masaki Kawai, Akimitsu Okamoto

We devised a chimeric molecule that enables E3-independent ubiquitination of MDM2 to promote its proteasomal proteolysis, offering a novel chemical framework for developing intranuclear protein degraders.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc04670c

item.title: Carbon interlayers in anode-free solid-state batteries: linking surface chemistry to lithium retention and recovery
item.description:
Authors: Tien Song Hiep Pham, Jihyeon Ryu, Donghwan Kim, Jun-Woo Park, TaeYoung Kim

A carbon-centred lithium ledger shows how carbon interlayers store, consume or strand lithium in anode-free solid-state batteries.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc06562g

item.title: Visible-light-driven, iron-catalysed aerobic oxidation of isoindolinones to phthalimides via chlorine-radical HAT
item.description:
Authors: Dan-Dan Liu, Shu-Ting Hu, Wen-Jing Xu, Dian Jin, Xue-Jiao Cong, Guliziba Tuerxun, Song-Lei Zhu, Zhou Xu, Yu-Chao Yuan

Air, blue light and 5 mol% FeCl 3 convert isoindolinones into phthalimides; a benzylic chlorination byproduct supports a chlorine-radical HAT pathway.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc06582a

item.title: Subtle differences in interlayer energetics dictate facet-dependent elastic and plastic flexibility in a molecular crystal
item.description:
Authors: Atiqur Rahman, Ravi Teja Malisetty, Amit Kumar Pradhan, Aditya K. Prajapati, Vivian G. Shang, John C. McMurtrie, Jack K. Clegg, Sajesh P. Thomas

A rare observation of facet-dependent elastic and plastic bending in a crystal is explored in terms of interlayer interactions and domain structural changes.

DOI: 10.1039/d6cc05977e

item.title: Sulfur-promoted direct conversion of benzylamines to aromatic nitriles under metal-free and air atmosphere
item.description:
Authors: Hui Gao, Zhaohang He, Changqun Cai, Hang Gong

Direct conversion of benzylamines to aromatic nitriles using a metal-free sulfur/DMSO system under ambient air.
